rows.note: claiming the finished Odonata from the Foundry grants a built Veritux

Prisma Veritux is a separate Mastery item.

disclosures.title: if you lose it
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells the blueprint for 100,000 standing. The build is 25,000 cr, 500 Rubedo, 1,000 Salvage, 2 Neurodes and 500 Circuits, 24h.
